known_debt: Zero test sources in all six code repos (five Java services and the frontend). The build workflow is the only automated signal.
.mvn/wrapper/ was never committed to any Java repo, so ./mvnw cannot bootstrap. Use mvn.
Four Java services keep their data in in-memory H2, so they cannot run more than one replica and a restart resets them to seed data. global-bank-rules has no database.
The five Java services have no Dockerfiles or k8s manifests. The shared k8s/Dockerfile.jar and all manifests live in global-bank-platform; the frontend has its own Dockerfile.
Inter-service URLs are env vars (CUSTOMER_SERVICE_URL etc.) defaulting to localhost; the Deployment must supply Service DNS names.
authentication's jwt.secret comes from JWT_SECRET and must be provided by a Kubernetes Secret in any real deployment.
Lombok was removed fleet-wide: 1.18.38 is the newest release and does not support JDK 25. It can return once a supporting version ships.
